profile.headline: Software Engineer II in Research at RTX BBN

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: Middletown, Rhode Island, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Develop and test software in C for deployed DoD Linux real-time software systems hosted on VPX and server based solutions.
- Develop software and interface specifications for external communication systems.
- Integrate components into a larger system in preparation for real world testing and deployment.
- Full stack development of tools in Qt/C++ and Python used internally and by project customers.
- Work in a Red Hat Linux environment and use Atlassian products for project organization and task management.
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Software Development · C++ · Qt · Software Testing

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Created and organized course materials, evaluated students' performance, encouraged and provided assistance to students both during and outside of class, maintained a current course website and online homework system.
positions.insights: Skills: Analytical Skills · Organization Skills · Communication · Teaching

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Evaluated students’ assignments, supervised labs, and maintained regularly scheduled office hours to support students, with a focus on creating a strong foundation of skills and concepts to be used in future courses. 

Assisted professors in the following courses:
- MTH 107: Introduction to Finite Mathematics
- MTH 180: Mathematical Tools in Computing
- CSC 110: Survey of Computer Science
- CSC 301: Fundamentals of Programming Languages

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Created and maintained a website and administered a Zoom meeting for the virtual ExploreCSR Google Event at the University of Rhode Island

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Worked in many areas of the agile software engineering process on a project team. Investigated and fixed errors in the code, reviewed others’ code changes, ran product verification testing, produced documents such as work instructions and analysis spreadsheets.

Organized and collaborated on the creation of an automated testing suite for the project, from participating in discussions and researching software options to developing Java code for the test suite.
positions.insights: Skills: Jira · Communication · Test Automation · Java · Agile Methodologies · Software Testing · Confluence · Software Development · Bitbucket · Team Leadership · Test Automation Framework · C++ · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Linux · Bash

positions.title: Gymnastics Instructor
positions.description: Led classes to develop strength, flexibility, and general fitness for students of various ages and skill levels and tracked attendance, participation, and performance data for all students

positions.title: Apprentice
positions.description: Studied alongside NUWC Division Newport scientists and engineers as part of the Undersea Technology Apprentice Program, hosted by the Naval Undersea Warfare Center. Worked with advanced technology while developing real-world applications of STEM skills learned in school.

honors.title: University Academic Excellence Award in Computer Science and Mathematics
honors.description: According to the University of Rhode Island, "the University Academic Excellence Awards are presented each year to graduating seniors who have proven to be exceptional students. These students have been selected by their respective departments as the most outstanding in their chosen fields. Each recipient receives a certificate of student excellence and a University of Rhode Island medallion."
honors.issuer: Issued by The University of Rhode Island · May 2022
